seo_title: Frnds — pizzeria and coffee shop in Astana, Esil
seo_description: Pizza on dough we make ourselves, breakfast all day and specialty coffee. Astana, Sagadat Nurmagambetov 25. Open daily 09:00–23:00. Pickup via WhatsApp.
hero_logo_alt: Frnds — pizzeria and all-day breakfast in Astana
hero_text: We cook with natural ingredients only: the dough ferments for 48 hours, the pasta is fresh, the bread and sauces are our own. Come by like a friend — or order in, we deliver.
breakfast_text: Breakfast runs from open to close, 09:00 to 23:00. Slept till three? No harm done — the syrniki and the eggs are still here. We'll make the coffee fresh to go with them.
about_text: A place where you're expected. Come without an occasion, stay a while, feel like one of us. Walk in like a friend 🧡

reviews.text: We came in at eight in the evening and ordered breakfast — syrniki and fried eggs. Nobody even blinked. The coffee was great too.
reviews.author: Aigerim

reviews.text: The pizza is on their own dough — thin, with a proper crust. We pick one up almost every Friday and it has never let us down.
reviews.author: Dmitriy

reviews.text: I sit here half the day with my laptop and no one rushes me. Specialty coffee, lemonades in summer — and they always say hello like I'm one of theirs.
reviews.author: Madina

howto.title: Eat in
howto.text: Walk in, no booking needed — and if you want a particular table, message us on WhatsApp and we'll hold it.

howto.title: Pickup
howto.text: Message us on WhatsApp and we'll get right on it. The moment everything's ready, we'll let you know — just swing by and take it home warm 🧡

howto.title: Delivery
howto.text: We run our own delivery 🧡 Message us on WhatsApp — we'll cook your order and bring it hot in proper thermal bags. FRNDS — now at your place too.

manifesto_text:
We cook with natural ingredients only. Our pizza dough ferments for 48 hours, the pasta is fresh, the bread and sauces are made in-house. Lemonades on real fruit purée, coffee on arabica — and breakfast even at nine in the evening, because comfort doesn't run on a schedule.

Come to Nurmagambetov 25. Or just order — we'll bring it over.
